Q1: (Z)-5-Octen-1-ol has a varied hazard profile. It is classified as a Tier 1 "Known Hazard" for dermal and eye exposure (SKN), indicating internationally recognized significant risks in this area. For endocrine disruption (EDC), it is categorized as a Tier 3 "Demonstrated Low/Moderate Hazard," suggesting a favorable safety profile based on direct studies. However, for carcinogenicity, mutagenicity, and reproductive hazards (CMR), environmental hazards (ENV), inhalation hazards (IHL), oral hazards (ORL), and organ/systemic hazards (OGN), the chemical is "Data Deficient" (Tier 4), meaning its risks are currently unknown due to a lack of sufficient information.
